dedupe_keys.name: open energy benchmark solver evaluation software

description: Open Energy Benchmark is Open Energy Transition's software for comparing optimisation solvers on energy-planning problems. It runs configured solver versions against LP or MPS problem files and presents measured runtime and memory use through CSV results and a web interface. Users select problems, solver configurations, years and resource limits; outputs support comparison across repeated benchmark runs. Coverage is a collection of energy-model problems, not a fixed geography or period. Public runner source is free under AGPL-3.0, while individual solver licences and problem metadata must be checked separately. A limitation is that benchmark rankings depend on hardware, solver settings and the selected problem set. The runner requires Linux with systemd, or an appropriate Linux environment, to enforce memory limits. It can help choose computational tools for energy-infrastructure simulation and optimisation, including problems generated with PyPSA (model-pypsa). The repository documents local runs and problem-generation configurations. No solver, LP/MPS file or container image was downloaded.
name: Open Energy Benchmark solver evaluation software
notes: G7 G7-0743. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. This record covers the benchmark runner, not a blanket AGPL claim over all external solvers or problem datasets.
